coco.description: Saved final epoch79 COCO bbox evaluation, independent models; no new inference. Values in [0,1], deltas in percentage points.

protocol.averaging: Exclude -1 cells. Equal seed average; AP includes 101 recall thresholds and ten IoU thresholds, AR100 averages ten IoU thresholds. AR50_100/AR75_100 are recalls at respective IoU thresholds.

notes.filter: Exclude iscrowd or ignore or nonpositive bbox width/height; no image decoding
notes.distinction: Standard category-aware COCO maxDets=100 limits ranked detections per image/category during matching; 300 queries bounds detector outputs and one-to-one training matches. Total GT >100 across categories does not itself imply hitting the COCO cap.
